name: measurement-protocol
description: Designs and runs a measurement of a noisy, moving system (for example how often a brand appears in AI answer engines) without inventing progress: one rule file, equal readings, held-out controls and brand questions, repeats clustered by question, a minimum detectable rate, a calibration run, and a list of blind spots. Use when asked to "design a measurement", "build a baseline", or "measure visibility".
